notes.title: V.1.2.4 patch update
notes.content:
Hey all! Hope you're doing well today. This update has just a couple small changes.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the player could not save or load the game in situations where the auto-save or save files were malformed.

Changes/Improvements:
- I added a few new pictures when transitioning between certain areas, to make things a little more engaging:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046009/59972b59e0159ca249eec43fe69c488e08d2c7fc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046009/43e11f339230b0f2f1c71e0df1ebafaf85c6a423.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046009/3b5c80660350dcd571a6ee9f97212650ff5d5e6d.png[/img]

I don't plan to add much more to the game at this point, but I'd really like to add achievements to the next build. So keep an eye out for that :)

Ok, that's all I have today. Have a fantastic day!
- Elias

notes.title: V.1.2.3 patch update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope your day is going well. Here are some more changes/fixes that I believe will improve your game experience.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the hacksaw would not spawn if you played the game twice (or more) without restarting the application or loading the game, which would make the game unwinnable. I honestly thought I had fixed this bug a ways back, but apparently not. Very sorry!
- Fixed some text not appearing when using certain actions in certain places.
- Fixed the opening dialogue to acknowledge that finals is NEXT week, not this week.
- Fixed a bug where re-lighting the candles in the church's first room will re-trigger the puzzle solution.

Changes/Improvements:
- Updated the flooded labyrinth again to make it even less (unfairly) confusing. Also can travel from the flooded labyrinth back to the sewers using a ladder.
- The mouse wheel can be used to switch between each action.
- A pause menu button was added to the gameplay interface. Now you can pause without needing to right click.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43046009/4bd03ecdb0732cc2d9073842bc40603e7b787453.png[/img]
- You can check the instructions screen from the pause menu.
- You can increase/decrease the master volume by 10% increments. The game now starts at 40% by default.
- Added two extra save files plus auto-save. Auto-save triggers each room (not counting transition events).
- Added more descriptions and feedback from action usage.
- Doors now automatically open when unlocked.
- Added a puzzle note for the statue room.
- When selecting an item, the "use" action is automatically also selected (assuming the "put" action isn't selected).
- Actions are highlighted when selected.
- The currently selected inventory page is now displayed as a page number.

These changes should help smooth out some of the rough edges. I still have not been able to reproduce any crashes, but auto-save should help out in case you encounter one. Enjoy, and have a great day!
- Elias

notes.title: Update on state of the game 1/13/23
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hope your day is going well :)

First off, I just wanted to thank everyone who has played the game! This was my first release on Steam, so I wasn't sure how things would go. I also really appreciate all the positive reviews that many of you have been leaving, it means the world to me.

So here's the news update: I read a couple reviews and noticed some players are running into crashes pretty often. So when I first released the game back in October, I wasn't seeing crashes anymore, and playtesters weren't seeing them either. It sounds like these flew under the radar. Sorry about that :( I've decided to take a look at the code base and work on fixing them to hopefully quash them.

For anyone who was reporting a crash, feel free to post a comment here if the game presented you with an error report. If possible, please include what you were doing at the time, as well as any info from the report.

I also saw a review from someone suggesting the ability to change actions using the scroll wheel to remove some of the manual pain of it. I honestly think that is a pretty good idea that I hadn't considered, so next patch will incorporate it. Any other small quality of life improvement ideas are appreciated. I can't guarantee that they'll all be added in, but I'll do my best.

I did see some comments about how not every action is necessary to completing the game. That is definitely true, and regrettably I did not add more usage for them, but ideally I don't want to change up puzzles post-release. What I might do is remove one of the actions and replace it with the "Move" action since the weird position of that one seems to trip people up. Not certain about it yet.

Ok, that's it for now, I'll post again when the update is done. Thanks again everyone!

- Elias

notes.title: V1.2.2 patch update
notes.content:
Hello there! Hope your day is going well. After I received wonderful feedback from players, I've released V1.2.2.

Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Updated the flood labyrinth to make it less confusing.
[*] Added more mallet usage. Smash away!
[*] "Pull" can now be used to open doors, not just "open". 
[*] The gas station key can now be "put" into the gas station door to unlock it, not just "used".
[*]  Added fullscreen and maximize capabilities. You can use "alt" + "enter" in combination to toggle fullscreen.
[*] Added an options menu to the title screen that lets you set the window size, look at credits, and check which endings you've discovered.
[*] From this build on, any endings you discover will be recorded, and you can view endings found from the options menu on the title screen.
[/list]
And here are the bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could move through the door in the puzzling stone room before solving the puzzle.
[/list]

Thank you all for supporting the game, and beware that which waits and watches in the darkness :)

- Elias
